headline: Weathered Expanse Leads Renewed Front-Line Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition, the heaviest contest has shifted further toward Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf. Weathered Expanse now records 58 strategic-base events in 24 hours, up from 52, with nine in the latest two hours; its ledger stands at five Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base, while enlistments are accelerating. Stlican Shelf has climbed to 54 daily events from 46 and remains divided, six Warden to three Colonial, with eleven events in two hours. Callahan’s Passage has edged from 16 to 18 daily events, though no fresh change appeared in the latest two hours. Godcrofts has risen to 23 events, but its last six hours brought only two and the latest two none. The once-busy Linn Mercy front has gone quiet in the latest two hours, its daily count now 12, while Marban Hollow shows four events in six hours and 13 across the day. Deadlands remains quiet since the earlier report, holding 16 daily events and all eleven bases under Colonial control. Elsewhere, Stonecradle shows heavy casualty activity but no fresh base events in six hours.
